{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|What wrist-casters you can find today are usually in unusable condition. The crossbow mechanism is warped or the band has torn; it is obvious that these little weapons saw a lot of use in years gone by.|[[Jorsk]]|<ref name="GFT" />}}
'''Wrist-casters''' were self-defense weapons that were used in the period of time some four thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The wrist-caster was a miniature [[Crossbow/Legends|crossbow]] mounted on an arm band that was secured around an individual's wrist.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> During the years surrounding the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], [[Drolan Plasteel]] manufactured the [[QuickShot]] wrist-caster.<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>
